summary: Staff editors can search Unsplash for hero images with attribution when UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY is configured.
detailed_changes: Added Unsplash search/select staff media endpoints that no-op cleanly without an access key.
Added an Unsplash picker on post and page editors that fills hero image URL, alt, and credit.
affected_areas: Public impact: hero credits when Unsplash images are selected
Internal impact: optional integration gated by env key
